findings: The new multiplication branch requires output dtype4, numel1, and unequal input ranks.
Unequal ranks and numel1 imply output rank>=1; admitted rank<=4 bounds the packed permutation shift to24 bits.
The existing insertion sort starts from reversed axes, compares left then right input strides, skips a comparison with a zero stride, and retains strict comparisons and shape ties.
For all-unit shapes, coalescing selects the final reordered axis stride. The successor reads that axis instead of a fixed leading axis.
Existing sorting and stride helpers are unchanged; no new allocation or owner path is introduced.
All other value kernels, original non-singleton and non-F64 priority branches remain source-bound to the parent.
Half_routes_unchanged_field_scope: Unchanged result-dtype5/6 priority branches; Half/F64 inputs promoted to result4 may take the new singleton branch.
